agency.name: Nexivo
agency.tagline: Everything your business needs to be found and chosen.
agency.description: Nexivo is a premier web design, SEO, and digital growth agency with hubs in London, UK and Ahmedabad, India. We build high-speed custom websites, rank them on Google, and drive consistent leads.
agency.payment_terms: 50% advance to commence work, balance upon delivery or go-live.

services.subtitle: Fast, phone-optimized websites with 1-tap WhatsApp lead triggers.

plans.name: Starter Plan
plans.details: 4 static pages, mobile-responsive design, WhatsApp click-to-chat, Google Maps and contact integration, 1 round of revisions. Live in about 10-14 days.

plans.name: Standard Plan
plans.details: Everything in Starter + 1-2 dynamic pages, services & pricing showcase, SEO-friendly architecture, 2 rounds of revisions, 1 month post-launch support. Live in about 14-21 days.

plans.name: Complete / E-commerce Plan
plans.details: Full dynamic site with e-commerce cart, payment gateway, product catalog setup, priority tech support, 3 months free maintenance.

services.subtitle: Show up when local customers search for your services.

plans.name: Local Boost

plans.name: Map Pack Domination

plans.name: National Authority
plans.details: 35 nationwide keywords, high-authority backlink outreach, weekly rank updates, competitor link gap analysis.

services.subtitle: Turn website visitors into paying customers.

plans.name: Omnichannel Scale

plans.name: Enterprise Growth

faq.question: What is your typical website turnaround time?
faq.answer: Starter sites take 10-14 days. Standard & complex projects take 14-21 days.

faq.question: What are your payment terms?
faq.answer: 50% advance to start work, 50% upon final review and delivery/go-live.

faq.question: Where are your offices located?
faq.answer: We operate dual hubs in London, UK and Ahmedabad, India.

faq.question: How do I download your 2026 brochure?
faq.answer: You can download it directly at https://www.studionexivo.com/Nexivo-Services-Brochure-2026.pdf or request it via form.
